d:
Indian Music Icon Niladri Kumar was called upon to add a regal touch to the grand Shubh Aashirvaad Ceremony for the presentation for the respected Prime Minister . The maverick won over the esteemed audience in his unique style and exquisute music prowess.
Sound of India featured an array of India's exceptional musicians along with a 60 Piece orchaestra conducted by the Music directors Ajay-Atul.
